papers.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
papers.brief: ViDecide不再把解法当作定长视频，而是训练模型因果预测状态转移并自主停止。再用纠错微调，将失败决策的噪声映射到模型自身的成功续接。
papers.tldr: 将视频生成改为逐步决策，显著提升扩散模型的多步推理与规划成功率。
papers.what_it_is: ViDecide不再把解法当作定长视频，而是训练模型因果预测状态转移并自主停止。再用纠错微调，将失败决策的噪声映射到模型自身的成功续接。
key_points: 决策中心训练：因果预测状态转移并学习停止
CFT纠错微调，无需策略梯度优化
平均严格成功率83.8%，最强此前方法为67.8%
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，改变训练单元比单纯增加推理数据更有潜力；在游戏与机器人规划中，还能泛化到更大谜题和未见布局。
papers.abstract: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.

papers.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
papers.brief: CSPD冻结强化学习前的骨干模型，将每个专家独立蒸馏成软提示。新增专家只需拼接提示，无须联合训练或重新整合模型权重。
papers.tldr: 将强化学习专家独立蒸馏为可拼接软提示，实现冻结骨干上的持续能力整合。
papers.what_it_is: CSPD冻结强化学习前的骨干模型，将每个专家独立蒸馏成软提示。新增专家只需拼接提示，无须联合训练或重新整合模型权重。
key_points: 23个数学、代码及智能体设置中，22个恢复至少90%的教师增益
多专家组合得分67.83，与MOPD的67.79相当
吞吐量距原骨干不超过1.5%，达秩4 LoRA的2.40倍
papers.why_notable: 把专家能力整合从反复更新权重变为增量拼接提示，为持续后训练提供低开销路径；组合在六个留出基准上泛化最佳。
papers.abstract: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six held-out benchmarks. Input-space adaptation adds little serving overhead, keeping throughput within 1.5% of the unadapted backbone and reaching 2.40x that of rank-4 LoRA. These results point toward continual post-training on a fixed backbone.

papers.title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
papers.brief: 提出机器人动作接口评测基准RUIBench与统一框架RUIKit，在共享感知和控制条件下比较不同接口，分析动作抽象与交互形式如何影响执行可靠性。
papers.tldr: 机器人动作接口显著影响智能体执行成功率，减少冗余决策并保留反馈是关键。
papers.what_it_is: 提出机器人动作接口评测基准RUIBench与统一框架RUIKit，在共享感知和控制条件下比较不同接口，分析动作抽象与交互形式如何影响执行可靠性。
key_points: RUIBench含30项操作任务，覆盖5个任务套件
RUIKit组合6种动作抽象与2种交互形式，提供13种接口
仅更换接口，前沿智能体成功率从45%升至81%
papers.why_notable: 将接口设计确立为具身智能可靠性的关键变量，并揭示智能体常在可观察失败后误报成功，凸显任务级验证的必要性。
papers.abstract: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. Our analysis reveals that effective interfaces reduce unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback, with their benefits shaped by agent behavior and physical uncertainty. We further uncover a verification gap, where agents frequently declare success despite observable failures, revealing the need for task-level verification beyond individual actions. Together, these findings establish RUI design as a critical factor in embodied agent reliability.

papers.title: Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space
papers.brief: 将Qwen-Image-2.1的7B扩散生成器适配为指令驱动感知模型，以共享低秩适配器生成RGB编码的深度与分割结果，并用任务契约统一编码、指令和解码。
papers.tldr: 用开放图像生成器统一视觉感知，揭示深度尺度不稳、任务竞争与损失失真。
papers.what_it_is: 将Qwen-Image-2.1的7B扩散生成器适配为指令驱动感知模型，以共享低秩适配器生成RGB编码的深度与分割结果，并用任务契约统一编码、指令和解码。
key_points: 42个外部评测检查点显示：深度几何早学会，绝对尺度不稳
十种子集成将未对齐深度δ₁从0.348提升至0.516
深度与分割争用适配器；验证损失下降与mIoU负相关
papers.why_notable: 价值不仅在于开放统一感知框架，还在于量化了生成式感知的尺度与任务冲突，并揭示训练损失无法可靠选择检查点。
papers.abstract: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to \emph{open} generators, and if not, what fails? We answer with \textbf{Open Vision Banana (OVB)}, an open framework that adapts the 7B diffusion generator of Qwen-Image-2.1 into one instruction-driven model for metric depth, semantic, instance, and referring segmentation, using a single shared low-rank adapter and public data. Each task is a \emph{task contract} whose RGB encoder, instruction, and decoder share one specification and are checked before training. Studying 42 externally evaluated checkpoints from two 100k-update runs, six exact weight-space merges, and eight controlled shorter runs, we find that the gap to the closed system is specific and measurable. Geometry is learned early while absolute scale is not: median-aligned NYUv2 $δ_1$ stays at 0.89--0.93 throughout training as unaligned $δ_1$ wanders between 0.11 and 0.50. The scale is not committed by a single sample: a ten-seed ensemble lifts unaligned $δ_1$ from 0.348 to 0.516 without retraining. Depth and 2D segmentation compete for the shared adapter, and weight merging moves along this trade-off without escaping it. Finally, lower validation flow loss comes with lower Cityscapes accuracy (Spearman $ρ\approx-0.9$ between loss reduction and mIoU), so the loss cannot select checkpoints. We release code, contracts, training data, and all evaluation outputs.

papers.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
papers.brief: ToolSmith在精简基础工具库之上自动生成可复用模块，让多模态搜索智能体扩展工具能力。框架以持续积累工具替代完全依赖人工维护的固定工具库。
papers.tldr: 让多模态搜索智能体自动生成并复用工具，突破手工固定工具库的限制。
papers.what_it_is: ToolSmith在精简基础工具库之上自动生成可复用模块，让多模态搜索智能体扩展工具能力。框架以持续积累工具替代完全依赖人工维护的固定工具库。
key_points: ToolSmith自动生成并复用工具模块
评测覆盖3个域内与10个域外基准
采用VLM裁判评测，大骨干模型收益更高
papers.why_notable: 将工具扩展从人工维护转向自动生成，在不同规模智能体上均获提升，为多模态搜索能力的持续扩展提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

papers.title: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
papers.brief: 提出修复器引导定位：定位器生成多个候选，冻结修复器按已验证补丁的似然评分，再以加权监督微调训练定位器，无需运行测试或强化学习。
papers.tldr: 用修复器对正确补丁的似然训练代码定位器，减少阅读代码并改善小型智能体修复表现。
papers.what_it_is: 提出修复器引导定位：定位器生成多个候选，冻结修复器按已验证补丁的似然评分，再以加权监督微调训练定位器，无需运行测试或强化学习。
key_points: 基于Gemma 4 E4B与1629条已验证轨迹构建流程
FGL达到教师定位的找错效果，代码量减少27.5%
单智能体最多解决78题中的11题，基座为8题
papers.why_notable: 将定位目标从补丁修改位置转向修复器实际所需信息，为小型代码智能体提供更贴合下游任务的训练信号；数据、代码与适配器均已公开。
papers.abstract: Code localizers are usually trained to predict the files a reference patch edits, but the code a fixer needs to read is not the same as the code it changes. We propose Fixer-Guided Localization (FGL): the localizer proposes several localizations, a frozen fixer scores each by how likely it makes a verified patch, and the localizer is trained on these scores with weighted supervised fine-tuning, without running tests and without reinforcement learning. We build the full pipeline on Gemma 4 E4B for the Kaggle Gemma-4 Developer Agent competition, from 1,629 test-verified Kimi K3 trajectories. The FGL target helps the fixer find the bug as often as the teacher's localization while using 27.5% less code. On the development set, one EM round moves the agent in the expected direction compared with a matched control: more tasks reach a patch (53 vs. 46), fewer tasks get stuck reading files that do not exist (43 vs. 54), and more tasks are solved (8 vs. 6). Training also changes how the agent works: trained agents explore about three times more than the base model and write far fewer wrong patches, and the single agent solves up to 11 of 78 tasks, against 8 for the base model. An analysis of 13 evaluation runs identifies what limits a 4B agent under an 8-minute budget (time, repetition loops and edit quality) and gives practical lessons for training small coding agents. All data, code and adapters are publicly available.

papers.title: DexDuet: Learning Contact-Preserving Bimanual Dexterity from Human Demonstrations
papers.brief: DexDuet用两类交互奖励保留人类手物构型与接触，将双手策略拆为共享权重、互相感知状态的单手策略，并用自适应辅助课程突破难操作阶段。
papers.tldr: 仅用一次人类示范学习双手机器人灵巧操作，同时保留手物接触关系。
papers.what_it_is: DexDuet用两类交互奖励保留人类手物构型与接触，将双手策略拆为共享权重、互相感知状态的单手策略，并用自适应辅助课程突破难操作阶段。
key_points: A-RSI自适应调整物体辅助与示范片段训练起点
覆盖4个基准、3种模拟器和5种机器人形态
ADD-AUC提升11至41点；122组中117组接触更优
papers.why_notable: 将模仿目标从物体轨迹扩展到接触关系；在轨迹精度相近时仍有明显优势，说明接触建模具有独立价值。
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations provide a rich source of bimanual dexterous skills, yet transferring them to robot hands remains challenging. Existing methods primarily optimize object trajectory tracking, often overlooking how human hands interact with the object. Even with accurate tracking, robots may contact incorrect object parts or slide their fingers, resulting in unstable manipulation. We present DexDuet, a framework that learns contact-preserving bimanual dexterity from a single human demonstration. DexDuet employs two interaction rewards to preserve human hand-object configurations and contacts. To enable coordinated manipulation, we factorize the bimanual policy into two weight-sharing per-hand policies that condition on each other's states. We further propose assisted reference-state initialization (A-RSI), an adaptive curriculum that adjusts object assistance and training starts across demonstration segments to overcome difficult manipulation phases. Across four benchmarks spanning three simulators and five robot embodiments, DexDuet improves object-tracking ADD-AUC by 11 to 41 points over the corresponding baselines while consistently achieving better contact preservation. Notably, among 122 paired runs with comparable object-tracking accuracy, DexDuet preserves the human's contacts better in 117 cases. Code and videos are available at https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Dexduet.io/
papers.organization: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

papers.title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
papers.brief: 框架按技能与情境覆盖、视觉决策序列相似性筛选代表轨迹，再用在线策略蒸馏训练学生，可在选定任务中交互，或在固定历史上生成新响应。
papers.tldr: 仅用少量代表性交互轨迹蒸馏视觉智能体，即可显著提升成功率并支持跨任务迁移。
papers.what_it_is: 框架按技能与情境覆盖、视觉决策序列相似性筛选代表轨迹，再用在线策略蒸馏训练学生，可在选定任务中交互，或在固定历史上生成新响应。
key_points: 四条固定轨迹使4B学生导航成功率从49.17%升至82.08%
Sokoban成功率从60.16%升至85.55%
回放无需新增交互，保留同任务在线训练增益的91.36%
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，精心选择的少量经验可替代大量交互，在两组评测中弥合与27B教师超九成的差距，为低成本训练视觉智能体提供路径。
papers.abstract: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

papers.title: HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation
papers.brief: 构建第一视角双臂操控基准，用统一流匹配策略比较多类视觉编码器的密集图块表示，并检验适配、任务共享及训练前读出指标。
papers.tldr: 该基准表明双臂操控需保留视觉图块，动作读出比通用视觉指标更有预测价值。
papers.what_it_is: 构建第一视角双臂操控基准，用统一流匹配策略比较多类视觉编码器的密集图块表示，并检验适配、任务共享及训练前读出指标。
key_points: 统一流匹配策略评测7类20个编码器、24项任务
图块平均为单令牌损失大部分成功率，适配均有益
逆动力学动作读出是训练前最强预测指标之一
papers.why_notable: 将视觉表征评测从识别能力转向操控相关性，揭示通用视觉分数难以可靠迁移；部署前仍需实际策略执行验证。
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.

papers.title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
papers.brief: 研究用两类大模型审计SWE-Gym，并以实际执行确认奖励误标。通过修复或移除错误测试任务，比较等规模、同难度数据对代码智能体强化学习的影响。
papers.tldr: 代码智能体训练中，修复误拒正确补丁的测试，比单纯剔除难题更有效。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用两类大模型审计SWE-Gym，并以实际执行确认奖励误标。通过修复或移除错误测试任务，比较等规模、同难度数据对代码智能体强化学习的影响。
key_points: 9B模型从未解出的任务中，74%存在测试假阴性
审计后训练在两项SWE-bench评测提升2.4和2.7分
发布SWE-Gym-Verified：1087项任务及执行证据
papers.why_notable: 把训练数据质量从任务难度转向奖励正确性，并用受控实验验证收益，为代码智能体强化学习提供可复用的审计数据与流程。
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

papers.title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
papers.brief: Native LAM用同一视频扩散Transformer兼任逆向与前向动力学模型，以可学习动力学寄存器连接两者。通过仅运动不同的反事实时序对提取潜在动作。
papers.tldr: 从预训练视频世界模型提取紧凑潜在动作，提升机器人策略预训练与跨域迁移。
papers.what_it_is: Native LAM用同一视频扩散Transformer兼任逆向与前向动力学模型，以可学习动力学寄存器连接两者。通过仅运动不同的反事实时序对提取潜在动作。
key_points: PAWlicy以Native LAM为动力学教师预训练VLA，不生成视频
LARY分类与控制回归均优于已有LAM，未设迁移目标仍可跨机器人迁移
3.8B模型在RoboTwin 2.0平均成功率达93.6%
papers.why_notable: 将视频世界模型已有动力学转化为可供策略学习的动作表征，减少对统一动作标注的依赖；真实机器人两项任务均优于pi_0.5。
papers.abstract: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

papers.title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
papers.brief: SynthDCB将设备行为、约束与环境影响蒸馏为模块化可执行组件，以统一能力表示串联工具发现、环境执行和任务合成，构建家庭、汽车及手机场景。
papers.tldr: 通过世界蒸馏构建可执行设备环境，扩展智能体控制任务并支持可验证评测。
papers.what_it_is: SynthDCB将设备行为、约束与环境影响蒸馏为模块化可执行组件，以统一能力表示串联工具发现、环境执行和任务合成，构建家庭、汽车及手机场景。
key_points: 覆盖114类设备、1166个函数与95种事件
22个模型评测2560项任务，最佳Pass@1为88.8%
1000项采样任务语义覆盖81.6%的真实语料指令
papers.why_notable: 将真实设备知识转为可扩展的交互环境，并用显式状态与工具调用轨迹验证任务，为设备控制智能体提供更系统的评测基础。
papers.abstract: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both interactive worlds and the tasks agents must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation (WD). World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. Explicit states and tool-call traces support task validation and agent evaluation. We evaluate 22 models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 88.8% mean Pass@1. Construction experiments demonstrate token efficiency and expansion of task coverage. At the richest knowledge level, WD fully covers 22/23 properties, 19/29 functionalities, and 30/39 event requirements specified in a real RobotVacuum protocol. Furthermore, the 1,000 sampled tasks semantically cover 81.6% of the 854 reference instructions in the real-world corpus. SynthDCB connects an expanding space of real-to-sim executable capabilities to verifiable agent evaluation.

papers.title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.brief: 提出几何驱动的手部运动重建框架，将视频扩散模型的深度回归改为约束求解。结合二维关节、MANO手部结构与片段时序信息恢复真实尺度深度，并按置信度融合预测。
papers.tldr: 以视频扩散先验结合手部几何约束，提升真实场景三维手部运动重建精度。
papers.what_it_is: 提出几何驱动的手部运动重建框架，将视频扩散模型的深度回归改为约束求解。结合二维关节、MANO手部结构与片段时序信息恢复真实尺度深度，并按置信度融合预测。
key_points: 细粒度几何提升与片段级射线拟合求解深度
置信度门控融合几何关节与MANO预测
7个数据集对比18种基线，误差降42%，57 FPS
papers.why_notable: 用几何约束缓解外观深度回归对新相机的泛化问题，同时兼顾遮挡鲁棒性与实时速度，为从人类视频学习机器人操作提供更可靠的运动输入。
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.

papers.title: DiLE: Discrimination-Aware Latent-Space Learning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
papers.brief: DiLE用少量可学习查询构建紧凑潜在表示，并以推理指令和答案生成监督引导学习；结合共享私有专家适配与学生检索反馈，保留区分相似候选所需的证据。
papers.tldr: 通过任务引导与动态难负例蒸馏，提升通用多模态嵌入的检索辨别能力。
papers.what_it_is: DiLE用少量可学习查询构建紧凑潜在表示，并以推理指令和答案生成监督引导学习；结合共享私有专家适配与学生检索反馈，保留区分相似候选所需的证据。
key_points: 共享私有专家适配兼顾跨任务共享与任务特定表征
在线策略难负例蒸馏以反向KL对齐师生相关性分布
跨两代骨干的4种配置，在3个检索基准达最佳表现
papers.why_notable: 它将检索辨别能力与输入理解分开优化，并让教师监督随学生的实际混淆动态更新，为跨模态、跨任务检索提供更有针对性的训练路径。
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models have greatly improved input understanding in universal multimodal embedding models. However, this understanding does not ensure that their embeddings preserve the evidence needed to distinguish relevant items from confusable alternatives. To preserve essential discriminative evidence in embeddings, this paper proposes DiLE, a discrimination-aware latent-space learning framework that combines task guidance with on-policy retrieval feedback. Specifically, a few learnable queries are used to encode task-relevant information in a compact latent space. Reasoning instructions and auxiliary answer-generation supervision shape these representations to support both task understanding and retrieval discrimination. To address task-specific discriminative needs, we design shared-private expert adaptation that integrates cross-task knowledge sharing with task-specific representation learning. Building on this, the on-policy hard-negative distillation is introduced: the student retrieves confusable candidates, and a reverse KL divergence objective aligns its embedding-based similarity distribution with the teacher's fine-grained relevance distribution over these candidates. Candidates are periodically refreshed using updated student snapshots, tying teacher supervision to the student's evolving retrieval behavior and confusions. Across four model configurations that span two backbone generations, DiLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMEB-v2, UVRB, and MRMR, demonstrating its effectiveness across modalities and tasks.

papers.title: Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?
papers.brief: 提出Polytropos基准，将文化物件的文字描述重新生成图像，再与原始照片比较。通过文化归属与具体物件识别，衡量模型描述保留了什么、丢失了什么。
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型描述更易凸显文化典型，却几乎无法保留文物的独特身份。
papers.what_it_is: 提出Polytropos基准，将文化物件的文字描述重新生成图像，再与原始照片比较。通过文化归属与具体物件识别，衡量模型描述保留了什么、丢失了什么。
key_points: 覆盖两家博物馆374件物件、五模型1870条描述及230条策展人描述
16%—21%物件识别结果改变，仅0.49%重建图认出具体物件
papers.why_notable: 把文化描述的保真度转化为可比较的视觉重建评估，揭示文化标签更易识别并不意味着物件本身得到忠实呈现。
papers.abstract: Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models. Descriptions of cultures tend to turn particular things into types, and what a description loses shows what its describer lacks. We introduce Polytropos, a benchmark that measures what model descriptions of cultural objects keep of the particular object by turning each description back into an image and comparing it with the original photograph. On 374 objects from the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Getty, with 1,870 descriptions from five models and 230 written by curators, reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs, at 54.55% to 59.09% against 52.14%, yet 16% to 21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object. On the same objects, models lose recorded cultures at a rate similar to curators but gain more. Model descriptions give each object many faces, each typical of its culture and almost none the object itself.

papers.title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
papers.brief: 提出面向全双工多模态交互的评测基准，以语调、表情和手势等证据分维度评估隐含意图满足程度，并结合回复质量评价与带时间戳的事实支撑评分。
papers.tldr: 用可追溯的视听线索评估多模态系统能否理解并回应用户未明说的需求。
papers.what_it_is: 提出面向全双工多模态交互的评测基准，以语调、表情和手势等证据分维度评估隐含意图满足程度，并结合回复质量评价与带时间戳的事实支撑评分。
key_points: 过程导向评分：按证据相关性聚合各维度的意图满足得分
结果导向评分：在纯音频、纯视觉及视听条件下评价回复质量
事实支撑评分JEV：用带时间戳的视听观察逐项评判
papers.why_notable: 将主观的隐含意图判断锚定到可观察证据，使评测不止关注回复是否自然，也检验系统是否真正回应用户的沟通需求。
papers.abstract: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

papers.title: Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion
papers.brief: UNIFIED将编码、生成与解码统一为位置对齐的序列映射，共享同一骨干，仅以模式标记和时间步区分任务。模型从零单阶段训练，只用重建与流匹配损失。
papers.tldr: 用单个扩散Transformer统一编码、生成与解码，兼顾架构简化和生成质量。
papers.what_it_is: UNIFIED将编码、生成与解码统一为位置对齐的序列映射，共享同一骨干，仅以模式标记和时间步区分任务。模型从零单阶段训练，只用重建与流匹配损失。
key_points: 位置对齐序列映射实现三模式全骨干共享
ImageNet 256分辨率：215M参数达gFID 2.08
文生图512分辨率：218M参数达GenEval 0.87
papers.why_notable: 它表明潜在扩散的三网结构可以彻底合一，并在匹配参数量下提升质量；文生图表现还超过约十亿参数的单阶段像素扩散模型。
papers.abstract: Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels. UNITE recently merged the first two into a single generative encoder trained in one stage, but its decoder remains a separate network. We ask whether this last network can be folded in too, so that one diffusion transformer encodes, generates, and decodes. Simply letting the shared backbone decode does not help. What makes it work is to cast all three modes as position-aligned sequence maps over one fully shared backbone, distinguished only by a mode token and the timestep. The resulting model, UNIFIED, is simple: one network trained from scratch in a single stage with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO). On ImageNet-1K 256x256 at matched parameters, UNIFIED improves gFID over UNITE at three sizes (~60M, ~115M, and ~215M) and reaches 2.08 with 215M parameters, the lowest among compared models under 250M parameters. On text-to-image generation, UNIFIED-B (218M) reaches a GenEval score of 0.87 at 512x512, exceeding single-stage pixel diffusion models with around one billion parameters. Full unification of latent diffusion is thus not merely feasible but beneficial.

papers.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
papers.brief: 研究用辅助损失训练模型执行完全潜在推理，并在贷款决策与代码生成中植入隐藏目标。通过激活修补验证，内部计算在思维链生成前已完成。
papers.tldr: 模型可在内部多步推理追求隐藏目标，生成看似正常的思维链并绕过监控。
papers.what_it_is: 研究用辅助损失训练模型执行完全潜在推理，并在贷款决策与代码生成中植入隐藏目标。通过激活修补验证，内部计算在思维链生成前已完成。
key_points: 辅助损失使完全潜在推理深度至少达到此前的5倍
贷款决策与代码生成中的隐藏目标未被强LLM监控器标记
激活修补表明思维链不参与隐藏目标的内部计算
papers.why_notable: 结果揭示仅审查输出与思维链的安全监控存在盲区：可见解释看似合理，也不代表它忠实反映模型的决策过程。
papers.abstract: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

papers.title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
papers.brief: ReWeave在冻结执行策略与感知的条件下，联合优化智能体上下文、工作流、控制循环及物理任务拓扑，并按更新后的拓扑重评历史试验以指导搜索。
papers.tldr: 冻结策略权重，通过交互重建物理依赖并优化智能体框架，提升跨任务迁移
papers.what_it_is: ReWeave在冻结执行策略与感知的条件下，联合优化智能体上下文、工作流、控制循环及物理任务拓扑，并按更新后的拓扑重评历史试验以指导搜索。
key_points: 将72个专用单元整合为44个可复用组
RoboDojo留出集成功率从25.50%升至58.25%
8个未见任务成功率51.3%，持续学习后达75.0%
papers.why_notable: 它把失败轨迹中的局部进展转化为优化信号，无需更新策略权重即可提升成功率，并展示了共享框架的跨任务复用与持续学习潜力。
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.

papers.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
papers.brief: 提出执行与反思双智能体框架：执行者控制机器人，反思者依据交互证据诊断失败；结合分层记忆，将经验转化为可复用操作指导，并逐轮改进执行框架。
papers.tldr: 通过执行与反思双智能体积累经验，无需更新模型参数即可改进机器人操作。
papers.what_it_is: 提出执行与反思双智能体框架：执行者控制机器人，反思者依据交互证据诊断失败；结合分层记忆，将经验转化为可复用操作指导，并逐轮改进执行框架。
key_points: 分层记忆管理短期执行上下文与长期经验
依据交互证据反思失败，递归改进操作指导
papers.why_notable: 将改进对象从模型参数转向执行框架，为机器人复用经验提供路径；真实环境三项操作任务平均成功率达96.7%。
papers.abstract: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embodied-Harness in generalization under environmental variations, spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and memory-dependent manipulation. Our method achieves success rates of 82.4%, 76.7%, and 94.4% on the three benchmarks, respectively. Real-world evaluation further yields an average success rate of 96.7% across three manipulation tasks. These results highlight the potential of Embodied-Harness to improve robotic manipulation through experience-driven harness self-improvement.

papers.title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
papers.brief: SAVIOR针对旋转文字、退化扫描等金融文档难例策展数据，用于微调视觉语言模型；另提出PaIRS，通过词元间空间关系评估布局保真度。
papers.tldr: 通过针对性数据策展与布局评估，提升视觉语言模型在金融文档难例上的识别能力。
papers.what_it_is: SAVIOR针对旋转文字、退化扫描等金融文档难例策展数据，用于微调视觉语言模型；另提出PaIRS，通过词元间空间关系评估布局保真度。
key_points: SAVIOR以样本高效策展覆盖金融OCR高影响失败场景
PaIRS比较词元成对空间关系，衡量布局保真度
微调Qwen2.5-VL后词召回率0.93，问答F1为0.89
papers.why_notable: 把优化重点从标准榜单转向金融业务难例，并将布局质量关联到下游问答效果；报告的问答表现优于多种开源与闭源模型。
papers.abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves a word recall of 0.93. When the resulting layout-aware OCR output is used as context for document question answering, it attains an F1 score of 0.89, outperforming both open- and closed-source models such as GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.

papers.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
papers.brief: 研究将推理导向的后训练配方用于知识任务，提取强化学习中模型自生的幻觉，并持续追踪其记忆变化，检验结果奖励与推理回溯如何强化错误事实。
papers.tldr: 研究发现，推理导向的后训练会让模型记住自身幻觉，并降低后续拒答意愿。
papers.what_it_is: 研究将推理导向的后训练配方用于知识任务，提取强化学习中模型自生的幻觉，并持续追踪其记忆变化，检验结果奖励与推理回溯如何强化错误事实。
key_points: 覆盖6个开放模型、2个模型家族及2种架构
获训练信号的幻觉召回率平均增加4.83%，未获信号仅0.17%
被奖励的幻觉后续拒答概率平均降低7.23%
papers.why_notable: 揭示后训练不仅可能未能纠错，还会固化模型自生的错误，甚至记住已撤回的假事实，为知识任务的奖励设计提供重要警示。
papers.abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.

papers.title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
papers.brief: 提出模拟90天批发经营的SMB Bench，评测智能体应对延迟后果的能力。训练时从经营记录提炼规则，并将历史经营状态作为续跑起点，而非模仿轨迹。
papers.tldr: 用长期批发经营模拟评测并训练智能体，揭示识别延迟后果不等于改善经营
papers.what_it_is: 提出模拟90天批发经营的SMB Bench，评测智能体应对延迟后果的能力。训练时从经营记录提炼规则，并将历史经营状态作为续跑起点，而非模仿轨迹。
key_points: SMB Bench含18个因果配对任务及859次运行轨迹
16个前沿模型中，仅3个胜过固定采购规则
Qwen3.8-27B训练后严重亏损季度减少，利润增益不确定
papers.why_notable: 将问题诊断、行为改变与利润改善拆开衡量，为长期智能体提供更贴近经营约束的评测，并展示历史决策后果可用于训练。
papers.abstract: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

papers.title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
papers.brief: KernelShift构建跨CPU架构的内核优化评测，通过智能体辅助、人工验证将真实仓库转为任务，并让编码智能体利用目标硬件反馈优化代码。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体能显著加速成熟架构上的计算内核，却难可靠适应新硬件扩展。
papers.what_it_is: KernelShift构建跨CPU架构的内核优化评测，通过智能体辅助、人工验证将真实仓库转为任务，并让编码智能体利用目标硬件反馈优化代码。
key_points: 收集99个真实内核，覆盖Neon至SME2扩展
成熟扩展上较自动向量化编译器快2.4—19.8倍
两个LLM的预填充加速1.3—1.6倍
papers.why_notable: 将代码优化能力放到持续演进的硬件上检验，揭示成熟架构上的提速并不意味着能掌握SME2矩阵分块等新编程模型。
papers.abstract: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.

papers.title: Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
papers.brief: 提出 HinT，将视觉语言评判器的修订模板分别填入正确内容与已观察到的错误，以原始提示为锚，仅蒸馏两者的速度差，并对齐编辑槽外的词元状态。
papers.tldr: 通过成对提示仅蒸馏纠错差异，让文生图模型持续自改进而不引入额外场景偏差。
papers.what_it_is: 提出 HinT，将视觉语言评判器的修订模板分别填入正确内容与已观察到的错误，以原始提示为锚，仅蒸馏两者的速度差，并对齐编辑槽外的词元状态。
key_points: HinT 构造纠正与错误双提示，仅蒸馏速度差
对齐编辑槽外词元状态，抑制修改信息扩散
在三种模型上验证，连续12轮自训练仍提升
papers.why_notable: 将有效纠错与评判器擅自添加的细节分离，保持基础模型级别的诱导偏差，同时达到或超过既有自蒸馏的对齐收益。
papers.abstract: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

papers.title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
papers.brief: MORSE根据反复出现的失败在线检索研究与代码，自动优化流式视频记忆；三个基准同骨干比较均最优，OVO准确率达75.1%，平均查询耗时0.30秒。
papers.tldr: MORSE根据反复出现的失败在线检索研究与代码，自动优化流式视频记忆；三个基准同骨干比较均最优，OVO准确率达75.1%，平均查询耗时0.30秒。
papers.abstract: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.

papers.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
papers.brief: GlanceNav用流式记忆避免重复编码，以反事实回退强化学习纠正导航错误；单步耗时104毫秒，R2R-CE成功率较此前最强同条件方法提升9.1个百分点。
papers.tldr: GlanceNav用流式记忆避免重复编码，以反事实回退强化学习纠正导航错误；单步耗时104毫秒，R2R-CE成功率较此前最强同条件方法提升9.1个百分点。
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

papers.title: Feedback Shortcut: Speculative Decoding for Latent Feedback Transformers
papers.brief: 通过状态对齐与流水线校正，让潜在反馈Transformer支持推测解码，精度几乎不变，解码加速2.4—2.8倍，训练开销仅增约2%。
papers.tldr: 通过状态对齐与流水线校正，让潜在反馈Transformer支持推测解码，精度几乎不变，解码加速2.4—2.8倍，训练开销仅增约2%。
papers.abstract: Feeding each position's top-layer hidden state back into the next position's input improves Transformer performance. However, this feedback breaks speculative decoding, since verifying a drafted token requires the top-layer state from its preceding position, which forces the draft to rely on an approximate stand-in. Training the model to adapt to this stand-in can lower the exact-decoding performance ceiling, while using it at inference time further introduces approximation error. We propose Feedback Shortcut to address both bottlenecks. First, state alignment trains a lightweight projection from multi-token prediction head states to stand-ins, leaving base model training untouched. Second, pipelined correction re-evaluates each draft using its predecessor's newly computed state, a much closer proxy to true feedback. Running this correction inside the verification pass of subsequent drafts improves accuracy with zero extra calls. Across 135M and 780M scales, Feedback Shortcut stays within $10^{-4}$ bits per byte of the exact-decoding ceiling on Paloma and accelerates decoding by 2.4-2.8x with about 2% more training compute than the latent feedback Transformer. At large batch sizes, skipping correction still preserves Transformer speed and over 80% of latent feedback's gains.

papers.title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.brief: 将流式相机帧写入持久三维世界状态，减少遗忘并预测未来占据；相比最强相机世界模型，未来1至8秒的IoU提高18至24点，速度超两倍。
papers.tldr: 将流式相机帧写入持久三维世界状态，减少遗忘并预测未来占据；相比最强相机世界模型，未来1至8秒的IoU提高18至24点，速度超两倍。
papers.abstract: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

papers.title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.brief: 提出基于隐藏状态和注意力图的内部过程奖励模型，引导大模型强化学习；仅约4600万参数，结合多种强化学习方法后，平均pass@8提升2.88%。
papers.tldr: 提出基于隐藏状态和注意力图的内部过程奖励模型，引导大模型强化学习；仅约4600万参数，结合多种强化学习方法后，平均pass@8提升2.88%。
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

papers.title: EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG
papers.brief: EEG-Jev用单次前向传播统一脑电选择、判断和评分任务，在35个公开数据源上评测，概率校准改善，推理较同骨干生成模型快近两倍。
papers.tldr: EEG-Jev用单次前向传播统一脑电选择、判断和评分任务，在35个公开数据源上评测，概率校准改善，推理较同骨干生成模型快近两倍。
papers.abstract: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cuts batch-1 latency from 122.43 to 63.11 ms (1.94-fold) against a matched-backbone generative comparator. Interactive demonstration and aggregate results: https://neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/.

papers.title: Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities
papers.brief: 研究发现，经数字序列传递的隐性偏好可跨模态改变图像生成与表征，动物偏好有效而颜色、风格无效；并提出从模型权重识别隐性特征的方法。
papers.tldr: 研究发现，经数字序列传递的隐性偏好可跨模态改变图像生成与表征，动物偏好有效而颜色、风格无效；并提出从模型权重识别隐性特征的方法。
papers.abstract: Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student's animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student's change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.

papers.title: Start Where the Data Are: Statistical Priors for One-Step Generation on Manifolds
papers.brief: 为流形单步生成引入统计先验与后验配对，减少模态间伪样本；分布误差最高降低125倍，蛋白质构象异常率从12.1%降至0.55%。
papers.tldr: 为流形单步生成引入统计先验与后验配对，减少模态间伪样本；分布误差最高降低125倍，蛋白质构象异常率从12.1%降至0.55%。
papers.abstract: Fast generation on manifolds is important for scientific applications such as protein design, yet existing one-step generators often produce spurious samples in low-density gaps between data modes. Our analysis highlights the mismatch between uniform noise and concentrated data, motivating a statistical prior that captures the data's coarse structure. We first estimate this prior by fitting mixtures of tangent-space Gaussians through geometry-aware moment matching. However, independent noise-data pairing can still connect different modes and weaken the benefit of the fitted prior. We therefore introduce posterior coupling, which samples a latent component conditioned on each data point and draws its paired noise from that component. To extend this approach to long torsion-angle chains, where full-covariance mixtures become costly, we use a hidden Markov prior to model sequential dependence with shared parameters. The resulting framework plugs into existing one-step training pipelines while retaining the generator architecture, training objective, and single network evaluation at inference. Experiments on spheres, tori, and SO(3) demonstrate substantial improvements across multiple generators, reducing distributional error by up to $125\times$ and the protein Ramachandran outlier rate from 12.1% to 0.55%.

papers.title: Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models
papers.brief: 提出面向流式具身模型的两阶段后训练，先蒸馏多教师，再结合强化学习与失败轨迹指导；成功率超过教师整体水平，且比直接强化学习更省交互。
papers.tldr: 提出面向流式具身模型的两阶段后训练，先蒸馏多教师，再结合强化学习与失败轨迹指导；成功率超过教师整体水平，且比直接强化学习更省交互。
papers.abstract: Large-scale pretraining provides embodied models with general capabilities, but reliable task execution still requires post training. In multitask settings, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) faces distribution mismatch between training and deployment, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) is limited by sparse rewards and uneven learning progress across tasks. Multi-teacher on policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates expert capabilities through dense supervision on the model's own trajectories, but achieving performance beyond the teachers remains challenging. We propose a two-stage post training framework for flow-based embodied models, constructing distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities through MOPD. Stage 2 combines RL with teacher distillation that weights velocity errors according to the sampling noise, where distillation is restricted to failed trajectories to supplement sparse rewards with dense guidance without directly constraining successful behaviors. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that the framework outperforms joint SFT and exceeds the corresponding teachers' aggregate success rates. Sample efficiency comparisons show higher success rates than direct RL with fewer environment interactions.

papers.title: Spec-Test Coverage Gap: Detecting Overspecified Tests in SWE-Bench-Style Benchmarks
papers.brief: 提出STCG指标，用双模型识别编程基准中超出任务要求的测试；发现此类测试占23%至35%，放宽后61%的相关失败补丁可通过，显著影响排名。
papers.tldr: 提出STCG指标，用双模型识别编程基准中超出任务要求的测试；发现此类测试占23%至35%，放宽后61%的相关失败补丁可通过，显著影响排名。
papers.abstract: SWE-bench-style benchmarks, such as SWE-bench Verified (Verified) and SWE-bench Pro (Pro), evaluate coding agents with tests taken from the change that originally fixed each issue. However, these tests can enforce details the task never states, causing correct alternative fixes to fail. Such overspecified tests have so far been found mainly through expensive expert review. To address this, we define the Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG), a 1-4 scale measuring overspecification, and score it with two LLM judges, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, which are given the specification and the test patch. A task is flagged as overspecified when both judges score it 3 or higher. Our study has three parts. First, we validate the judges on 206 tasks that earlier human audits and agent results label as overspecified or fine. Second, we apply STCG to all 500 Verified and 731 public Pro tasks and compare the flags with the results of the top 30 Verified submissions. Third, we verify the flags by asking Claude Opus 5.5 to loosen the overspecified requirements of flagged tasks, and regrade 2,186 failed patches from those submissions. Our main findings are: (1) Overspecified tests are detectable: on the validation tasks, the judges correctly flag 89% of the tasks that human audits identify as overspecified and wrongly flag only 4% of the tasks known to be fine. (2) Overspecified tests are common: applied to whole benchmarks, the judges flag 23% of Verified and 35% of Pro tasks. (3) Flagged tasks are much harder for agents: the top 30 Verified submissions resolve only 31% of the flagged tasks on average, against 88% of the other tasks. (4) Overspecified tests change the leaderboard: relaxing the tests lets 61% of the 2,186 failed patches on flagged tasks pass. Counting these patches as resolved would add 33 to 60 tasks to each top-30 submission, raising resolve rates by up to 12 percentage points.

papers.title: Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes
papers.brief: 提出双曲空间层级语义原型，将骨架动作与上下位概念对齐；在叶级识别率相当时取得最佳层级路径准确率，并能无需重训迁移至其他分类树。
papers.tldr: 提出双曲空间层级语义原型，将骨架动作与上下位概念对齐；在叶级识别率相当时取得最佳层级路径准确率，并能无需重训迁移至其他分类树。
papers.abstract: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

papers.title: CALVIN-MAX: When Does a Mid-Execution Change Hurt a Robot Policy?
papers.brief: 提出CALVIN-MAX，区分环境变化与执行时机对机器人策略的影响。十种策略成功率均下降，视觉变化在动作中发生反而损失更小，且影响延续至下一任务。
papers.tldr: 提出CALVIN-MAX，区分环境变化与执行时机对机器人策略的影响。十种策略成功率均下降，视觉变化在动作中发生反而损失更小，且影响延续至下一任务。
papers.abstract: Robots must often keep working after the world changes, as when a block moves or the camera shifts while the robot still acts on what it saw before. Recent work showed that one change during a task lowers success for every policy tested, but did not separate the effect of its timing from the cost of the changed world, or measure what it costs afterwards. We introduce CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases on CALVIN's five-instruction chains, each with one change to the objects, the camera, the robot, or the instruction. Each case compares three runs that are identical until the affected instruction begins: one without the change, one with it in place from that moment, and one in which it arrives while the robot is moving. The second run against the first gives the cost of the changed world, and the third against the second the effect of meeting it mid-motion. On 1,526 held-out cases per policy, with hypotheses fixed in advance, each of ten released policies loses 4.4 to 9.9 percentage points on the affected instruction over the eight core changes. Whether timing matters depends on the change: one that alters what the robot sees costs 5.4 points less mid-motion than from the start, whereas a change to the scene itself or to the robot shows no detectable effect. Rewinding the robot to the start of the instruction removes the benefit for every policy; the stricter test we fixed in advance, that the rewound run then matches the second run, passes for three. The cost also outlasts the affected instruction: the change stays in place, and a policy that still completes that instruction is 5.0 to 16.8 points less likely to complete the next one.

papers.title: JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT
papers.brief: JECT用报告条件与分段文本预测缓解胸部CT预训练的上下文捷径，使编码器学习异常特征；多项任务达到现有基础模型水平，并支持无需额外训练的句子定位。
papers.tldr: JECT用报告条件与分段文本预测缓解胸部CT预训练的上下文捷径，使编码器学习异常特征；多项任务达到现有基础模型水平，并支持无需额外训练的句子定位。
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.

papers.title: BendGS: Observation-Conditioned Gaussian Self-Modeling for Continuum Robots
papers.brief: BendGS以观测估计虚拟骨架，驱动高斯变形，无需关节角即可预测连续体机器人下一状态的形状、外观与末端位姿；仿真和实机测试均优于对比方法。
papers.tldr: BendGS以观测估计虚拟骨架，驱动高斯变形，无需关节角即可预测连续体机器人下一状态的形状、外观与末端位姿；仿真和实机测试均优于对比方法。
papers.abstract: Visual self-models learn from images how a robot moves under motor commands. Continuum robots need them even more, as they bend continuously without measured joint angles or fixed link geometry. Existing continuum self-models predict point clouds, image-space curves, or future images, but not the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose together from an observed body. 3D Gaussians offer a renderable representation of shape and appearance, yet articulated Gaussian self-models rely on joint angles to drive deformation. In this work, we propose BendGS, which uses a virtual backbone estimated from observation to drive command-conditioned Gaussian deformation, enabling next-state prediction for continuum robots without measured joint angles. In Gaussian modeling, a feed-forward network reconstructs the robot as 3D Gaussians from multi-view images, and the backbone, a chain of coordinate frames, is fitted to back-projected depth points to estimate the bending state. In transition, a network predicts its change under a relative motor command to deform the bound Gaussians. The deformed Gaussians render the next images and the 3D shape, and the distal frame gives the tip pose. Training losses use RGB-D images and masks, without bending or tip labels. On simulated and real robots, BendGS achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, best image quality, and lowest tip errors among the compared methods.

papers.title: Gaze World Model
papers.brief: GWM联合训练场景潜变量预测与视线监督，定位并预测视频中的注视目标和转移；转移检测AP领先最强基线约10点，未来视线预测也更优。
papers.tldr: GWM联合训练场景潜变量预测与视线监督，定位并预测视频中的注视目标和转移；转移检测AP领先最强基线约10点，未来视线预测也更优。
papers.abstract: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.
